content.text: Converting between beat time and wall time

inlineContent.text: takes a snapshot of a tempo map, so later changes to the
map do not affect it, and converts in either direction:

code: converter.wallTime(at: 1)               // when the music is one whole note in
converter.beatTime(at: WallTime(doubleValue: 2)!)  // how far in the music is after 2 seconds

inlineContent.text: At a steady tempo, a length of beat time lasts its length × 60 /
seconds. At ♩ = 60, a whole note lasts 4 seconds.
